newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela electricity firms seen needing to invest.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela electricity firms seen needing to invest.

text.p: Three Venezuelan state-owned electricity distributors, Cadafe, Enelbar and Enelven-Enelco, need to make investments of $1.4 billion in the next three years to maintain adequate service, a top government official said on Tuesday.

"They need this money, which is equivalent to 675 billion bolivars and they do not have these resources," Mariano Crespo, general manager of state body Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) told a congressional committee.
The FIV has been preparing the electric distribution companies for privatization for over a year but can only spare $200 million for the necessary investments, Crespo said.
An increase in electricity tariffs would help the companies make the investments, he added.
Venezuela's Electricity Regulatory Committee is currently considering an increase in electricity tariffs based on each company's costs structure.
